page.layout: One centred title page: title lines at top, a motto in italic, a woodcut coat of arms (a bear in a roundel) in the middle, then the printer's imprint and date at the foot. No running head, page number or signature.

l.i: Beatus ille cuius voluntas est in lege Domini,
& qui in ea die ac nocte meditatur. Psal. 1.

page.notes: The woodcut in the centre is a coat of arms: a bear standing on its hind legs inside a shield, within an oval-bead roundel. It is not text and is not transcribed. The date line is printed as cIↄ Iↄ LXXVIII, which is MDLXXVIII. The title word "PSALMVM" is printed with V; following the u/v rule it is given as MUM. "LAVSANNÆ" is given as LAUSANNÆ for the same reason. Handwriting ("137", "2", "U 1603", "1") and the library stamp and shelf mark (V 856/2, Bibliothèque Cantonale) are not transcribed.
